toy_only_data.train_generator: Pure Python deterministic local public six-field outcomes, no original source code. Each episode hides one binary context bit = seed & 1; public before is seeded bit, action chosen by independent deterministic logging policy random.Random(seed*8191+31) with independent action bits; public reward = int(action==hidden), next visible before = before ^ action ^ ((seed+step)&1), episode closes at step 8. Hidden bit never passed to any learner; only previously witnessed rewards. The environment rule itself is authored as an experiment fixture and is not evidence of novel causal discovery.

recurrent.architecture: vanilla non-native conventional Elman RNN, 8 tanh units, 6 public non-token numeric inputs (before,action,prev_action,prev_reward,has_previous,constant); one Bernoulli immediate reward readout
recurrent.optimization: full sequence exact backpropagation through time on 96 generated complete training episodes; CPU float64 deterministic initialization Random(1707); 48 epochs, batch updates after each complete 8-step train-only episode in sorted order, SGD learning rate 0.06, per-step weighted Brier loss (p-r)^2; per-parameter gradient clamp[-5,5]; no validation-driven hyperparameter selection; holdout used only after frozen training
recurrent.train_objective: observed action immediate binary reward Brier under logging policy, not unexecuted action or four-step target
recurrent.success_predeclared: all 48 train epochs complete and source-only train Brier decreases >=0.02 absolute vs epoch0 untrained; validation Brier is measured but no tuning/selection or claim from this fabricated generator
recurrent.cold: hash-sealed snapshot with full trained weights and public latent state; exact restore of action and state, strict 6-field public observations and no replay
recurrent.cost: measure training CPU wall seconds and serialized weight state bytes, not substitute for real original source whole-process efficiency

exploration.method: deterministic seeded uniform binary public exploration with Random(seed), choosing next action based only on public state/history and local pseudo-RNG; fixed random seed 1777 for independent test, no future labels or origin source private access
exploration.cold: lossless portable RNG state + hash-verified public trace, closed episode safeguards
exploration.fitness: both native and recurrent expected policy interface choose(observed_state,tuple(prior_public_consequences)) then observe(six-field-public-event); exact original per-arm budget same for mock tests
